notes.title: Patch Notes 0.5.1 - Feedback One
notes.content:
Patch Notes: 0.5.1 Minor Update

- A requisition for higher quality bullets have been approved by the precinct. All standard issue bullets are now faster.

- Removed some restrictions leading to sub-optimal runs on locomotion in the proving grounds based on user feedback.

- Fixed bug where game used 2 grenades instead of 1 when using the grenade launcher.

- Fixed bug where the health power up in Survival cost too much.

- Fixed bug in survival mode where some scores were not being reported in the correct unit.

- Upgraded to Unity 5.5.

- Detectives at the precinct have noticed that the letters in the tItle screeN may hold the key to nEw, untested expeRiences.

notes.title: Update 0.5.0 - Lone Survivor is now available!
notes.content:
Happy Holidays from our team at Codeate!

In the spirit of the holidays, we're joining the winter sale and offering 10% off!

[img]http://i.giphy.com/3o6ZsTz4KUGHoDwum4.gif[/img]

We've also updated The Torus Syndicate to 0.5.0, dubbed Lone Survivor.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26773827/705a2ca7d75e439f420053bc1b59f06ab9068b7c.png[/img]

[h1]Survival Mode[/h1]

Face off against the syndicate's goons as you fight for survival in the new [b]survival mode[/b], complete with competitive leaderboards!

[b]Features[/b]

- Survive the onslaught as you defeat increasingly difficult waves.

- Competitive Leaderboards

- Randomized enemies keep the action fresh during each play through.

- Collect coins from defeated enemies and spend it on power-ups.


[h1]Gameplay Changes & Bug fixes[/h1]

[b]Changes[/b]

- The SMG now operates in full-auto.

[b] Bug Fixes [/b]

- Fixed a bug in the Proving Grounds where the player could drop the pistol

- Fixed a bug in the Proving Grounds where the leaderboard does not show your current rank unless in the top 10 places.

notes.title: Patch 0.4.8 - Mini-Update: "Cognitive Science"
notes.content:
This week's update features a small but significant change to the way many of the enemies and NPCs look, as well as some under-the-hood changes that we're very excited about.

Enemies and NPCs alike will now react in a more human way with various facial features such as blinking, wincing, and speaking. This is a small detail that we really loved putting in, as it made the characters much more human.

Most of the time this week was spent doing some under-the-hood changes to the way the enemy spawning system worked, in preparation for the Survival update next week. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch 0.4.6
notes.content:
The Torus Syndicate Update 0.4.6

Achievements are here! We also made some tweaks to the interface, and added a <REDACTED> thing in the title screen.

Achievements
- We added the beginnings of the achievement system with some fun little things you can do to get them. More to come!

Interface
- Added a low ammo warning when there is less then 20% ammo in the gun.
- Some players were having trouble when they're out of SMG ammo. We've made the text more clear
- Removed the bright floor boundries. Scenes are now 7% more immersive.
- Moved the spawn point of new SMG ammo to a more accessible location. Let us know if it's better then before!

Bug Fixes/Improvements: 
- Machine Gun Joe spends way too much time throwing grenades and not much time Machine Gunnin'. The Bureau of Appropriate Bad guy names have filed a formal complaint, and as such, Machine Gun Joe now spends slightly more time Machine Gunning.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.4.5
notes.content:
- Reloading V3.0:
  - Players now have a visible "Ammo belt" that they can see. Pick up new ammo from the belt by bringing the off-hand to the belt. Gripping is not required. Let us know what you think!

- Grenades:
 - New players are unaware that grenades can be destroyed by shooting at them. We added a very visible warning the first time this happens to teach this mechanic.

Bug Fixes/Improvements: 
- Fixed a bug where the throwable powerup does not give more powerups if the amount reaches 0.
- Made some dialogue more readable in the tutorial scene at the Gun range.
- Fixed issue where the handgun could obstruct vision
- Updated the Tutorial to reflect new changes to the reloading system.
